name: glassbox
description: Fast typed decisions about code, with probabilities, confidence and checked reasons. Runs on your Claude Code model through the claude CLI, so no extra keys.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Which model glassbox asks. auto (default) uses the host agent's own CLI (claude -p in Claude Code), so no key is needed. anthropic and openai-compat are optional API backends for CI or headless use.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id for the chosen backend. Leave empty for the default (haiku for claude-cli).

enable_hooks.title: Enable hooks
enable_hooks.description: Mark edited files stale after Edit, Write and MultiEdit, and refresh the AGENTS.md block at session start. Only acts in repos where you ran `glassbox init`.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Only for the anthropic backend. Not needed with auto or claude-cli.

openai_base_url.title: OpenAI-compatible base URL (optional)
openai_base_url.description: Only for the openai-compat backend, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.
